title: Zeus Ion 510 Magnetic Adapter Silver
description:
AVAILABLE IN SILVER COLOR

The Zeus ION 510 Magnetic Adaptor Set showcases a remarkable balance of creativity and technical prowess. Designed to fit seamlessly with all 510 cartridges, especially the Zeus Ion, this adaptor set ensures a perfect fit and easy swapping between different cartridges.

VERSATILE COMPATIBILITY
This adaptor set isn’t just versatile – it also provides high-quality performance. With two magnetic adapters, it allows you to use both 0.5 ml and 1.2 ml cartridges, making it a must-have for any vaping enthusiast.

EASY TO USE
The Zeus ION 510 Magnetic Adaptor Set is designed with user convenience in mind. The magnetic adapters make it incredibly easy to swap between different cartridges. Whether you’re at home or on the go, this adaptor set makes swapping cartridges simple and quick.

DURABLE AND RELIABLE
Crafted from high-quality materials, the Zeus ION 510 Magnetic Adaptor Set is built to last. Its robust construction ensures long-term reliability, so you can trust it to work every time. Both adapters are slightly different because they are meant for different sized cartridges.

Cartridge not included
